title: SAS utils
description: Shared sub-schemas reused by every SAS per-type document (mosfet, diode, igbt, bjt). Component-specific electricals, modelParams and curves live in the per-type files.

part.title: semiconductorPart
part.description: Part identification — shared across all semiconductor types. Extends the PEAS datasheetInfoPartBase with semiconductor-specific fields.

subType.description: Per-device-type subtype. The legal values are NARROWED BY EACH DEVICE SCHEMA (mosfet/diode/igbt/bjt.json) to a closed enum; this shared def only fixes the type. Optional: omit when unknown.

package.description: Manufacturer's exact package designation (e.g. Infineon PG-TDSON-8). Complements case, which holds the generic industry code.

mechanical.title: semiconductorMechanical
mechanical.description: Mechanical specs — extends PEAS datasheetInfoMechanical with a package case field.

case.description: Package name (TO-220, SOT-23, etc.) — mirrors part.case for convenience.

pinout.description: Per-terminal function map (shared PEAS type, hoisted 2026-08): (pin, name, function) triples — e.g. G/D/S plus kelvinSource on 4-lead packages. Same package does NOT imply same pinout (pin-swapped second sources exist).

landPattern.description: Manufacturer-recommended PCB land pattern (shared PEAS type, hoisted 2026-08): pad centres, copper sizes and drills exactly as the datasheet's recommended-layout drawing publishes them.

spiceModel.title: spiceModel
spiceModel.description: The device's SPICE .model card, carried as structured data for simulator-agnostic round-trip (ngspice and LTspice consume .model cards identically). This is the canonical home for a device whose source is a simulation model rather than a datasheet — it lives at the device-body top level so it does not require the manufacturerInfo/datasheetInfo chain. Nothing is fabricated: a bare card such as '.model Red D' yields modelType 'D' and an empty parameters object.

modelName.description: Model name exactly as it appears in the .model card (e.g. '1N4148', 'Red').

modelType.description: SPICE model type keyword following the name in a .model card (e.g. 'D' for diode, 'NPN'/'PNP' for BJT, 'VDMOS'/'NMOS'/'PMOS' for MOSFET, 'NIGBT' for IGBT).

parameters.description: SPICE .model parameters as name -> value, SI-resolved (numbers, or strings for non-numeric flags). Empty object when the card carries only type defaults.
